96.description: This vector represents linguistic suffixes and character combinations, particularly from Thai script transliteration and common English morphological endings.

119.description: This feature vector represents the Thai noun-forming prefix and word for "act," "process," or "system" (การ).

39.description: This feature vector activates strongly on conjunctions, relational particles, and connecting words predominantly in Thai and English.

33.description: This vector represents multilingual morphological suffixes and roots related to labor, work, and occupational terms.

120.description: This feature vector activates strongly on mixed multilingual text fragments, particularly Thai script tokens and miscellaneous technical abbreviations or proper noun subwords.

57.description: This vector represents common Thai vocabulary words and morphemes.

76.description: This feature vector represents concepts and terminology related to robots, robotics, and artificial intelligence.

186.description: These tokens represent common Thai character sequences, monosyllabic words, and sub-word units frequently used in the Thai language.

68.description: This vector activates for common name prefixes, word fragments, and phonetic components beginning with the letters "ro" or "rob".

141.description: This feature vector activates strongly on proper names and personal identifiers across multiple languages and scripts.
